# Cribbage Trainer: Count & Peg

> Cribbage Trainer is a free cribbage practice app for iPhone and iPad. Five-minute drills on counting the hand, choosing the discard and pegging to 31.

## App

- [Cribbage Practice App for iPhone | Cribbage Trainer](https://jackwallner.com/ios/cribbage/index.html.md): Cribbage Trainer is a free cribbage practice app for iPhone and iPad. Five-minute drills on counting the hand, choosing the discard and pegging to 31.

## Guides

- [Best Cribbage App for iPhone (2026): 5 Compared](https://jackwallner.com/ios/cribbage/best-cribbage-app.html.md): The best cribbage apps for iPhone and iPad compared in October 2026: full games, discard analyzers, hand scorers and drills, with each one's trade-offs.
- [How to Count a Cribbage Hand | Cribbage Trainer](https://jackwallner.com/ios/cribbage/how-to-count-a-cribbage-hand.html.md): How to count a cribbage hand step by step: fifteens, pairs, runs, flush and nobs, five worked examples, the 29 hand, and the scores that cannot happen.
